title: Sportneer Folding Camping Table — Height Adjustable, 60 × 40 cm
short_description: Small folding table by Sportneer with 2 height positions and a mesh layer. Aluminium frame and tabletop, size 60 x 40 cm, weight 2.72 kg.
long_description: The Sportneer folding table is a small, height-adjustable camping table with 2 height positions and a mesh layer under the tabletop. Frame and tabletop are made of aluminium and the tabletop measures 60 x 40 cm. The table weighs 2.72 kg and, according to Amazon, supports up to 30 kg. Folded, it measures 33 x 17 x 14 cm. The table and an instruction manual are included. The variant shown here is the black version.
